Uniform expansion yields a square-root aperture with relative O(epsilon) even at the integration boundary. The exact triangular integral is (4/15)epsilon^(5/2), producing the stated coefficient. The rare-event Jacobian gives normalized Dirichlet(1,1,1/2,1). The normalized coefficient has strictly positive logarithmic derivative 5/(2z)-2/sinh(z)-1/sinh(2z). Actual standalone quadrature checks six parameter pairs and Dirichlet conditional means; finite runs are corroborative, not the proof.
